source_line:
return <>
Correct solution

An in-range queen in every row, unique columns, exactly one hit per region, and no touching pair.

Strict pass

The original output also satisfies the exact JSON-only schema. Post-hoc extraction is a separate diagnostic.

Elapsed API time

Monotonic client time through full response receipt; not isolated model compute or preparation time.

Confirmed USD

Returned usage.cost. Missing charges are not zero; allowance is reservation, not billed amount.

The October generation replay reuses the three original board images; later Jev studies use small, study-specific cohorts, including six held-out construction boards and nine trajectory boards. These do not establish broad distribution coverage. Clean images, region letters, singleton regions, preview model versions, unequal provider conditions, and generator-family reuse all constrain the inference.

The same board appears in several conditions and candidate lists overlap. Analyze at board level; do not manufacture tiny p-values by multiplying correlated decisions.
